verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of an in-product assistant is an "Ask Fellow" line item on the pricing page, with no description of what it can do. The detailed Q&A capability ("Ask anything about your meetings") belongs to the MCP server, which serves external chatbots like Claude or ChatGPT, so it is not credited as a built-in assistant. Automatic summaries and suggested action items are AI features, but they are not task delegation. Missing for 10: documentation of what Ask Fellow does, evidence that it can take delegated tasks or actions rather than only answer questions, any description of its scope or workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
